summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K (UK equivalent of an issuer share-repurchase disclosure) announcing open-market purchases under its share buyback programme announced 29 October 2026. The company bought 4,492,636 ordinary shares across 29–30 October 2026 as treasury shares, at volume-weighted averages of 318.23p and 322.97p, with a high of 334.00p and low of 310.60p. Post-settlement registered capital is 8,808,341,409 shares, with 16,238,543 in treasury and 8,792,102,866 voting. Watch execution pace and any acceleration or suspension signals.
